meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性

copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 启动后，Claude 会组建一个 5 人安全研究团队（3 名漏洞猎人、2 名 PoC 工程师），并行审计代码仓库：找出疑似漏洞、用最小化验证手段证明是否真能被利用，并按可利用性分级给出最终报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“security-research”、“security review”等关键词，或要求做漏洞审计、发布前安全审查、威胁模型验证等时触发；韩语“보안 리뷰”等也可触发。需开启 Team 模式并处于主会话。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前分支与上游的差异，找出可利用漏洞

howto.what_en: Once launched, Claude forms a 5-member security research team (3 vulnerability hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit the codebase in parallel: surface suspected vulnerabilities, prove exploitability with minimal verification, and deliver a report with severity calibrated by actual exploitability.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords such as "security-research", "security review", or requests for vulnerability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation; Korean triggers like "보안 리뷰" also work. Requires Team Mode and main session.

say_en.text: Security-research audit the branch diff vs upstream for exploitable bugs.
say_en.note: Launch team audit with severity scoring.

say_en.text: Review this PR for auth, injection, data-isolation flaws.
say_en.note: Hunters scan in parallel by role then report candidates.

say_en.text: Audit this repo for vulnerabilities, add minimal PoC and fixes.
